name: @activepieces/piece-flow-parser
description: Upload, process, and manage documents programmatically with FlowParser's REST API.

auth.description:
To get your API Key:

1. Go to your FlowParser account
2. Navigate to API settings
3. Copy your API key
4. Paste it here

upload_document.name: upload_document
upload_document.description: Upload a new document to FlowParser for processing

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a document file to FlowParser, which queues it for OCR/parsing and returns its document ID; use this to ingest a file before its parsed data becomes available (typically via the parsed-document triggers). Requires the file binary as input. Not idempotent — each call creates a new document and uploading the same file again produces a separate document.

new_parsed_document_by_template.name: new_parsed_document_by_template
new_parsed_document_by_template.description: Triggers when a new document is parsed using a specific template

templateId.description: Select a template to monitor for new parsed documents

auth.description:
To get your API Key:

1. Go to your FlowParser account
2. Navigate to API settings
3. Copy your API key
4. Paste it here

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a document is successfully parsed in FlowParser using the specific template selected in this trigger, polling for status changes scoped to that template ID. Represents a newly extracted/parsed document tied to one parsing template, letting downstream steps act only on results from that template.

new_parsed_document_found.name: new_parsed_document_found
new_parsed_document_found.description: Triggers when a document has been successfully parsed

aiMetadata.description: Fires whenever any document reaches the parsed status in FlowParser, polling all status changes regardless of which template was used. Represents a newly extracted/parsed document and is the template-agnostic counterpart to the by-template trigger.
